news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Sets Q2 Results Date and Completes Full C$7.52 Million Offering
Intermountain Health Brings Perimeter's Claire™ to the Operating Room, a Landmark in Breast Cancer Surgery Using AI
news.summary: Intermountain Health became the first U.S. health system to commercially deploy Perimeter's Claire OCT system, the only FDA-approved AI-enabled imaging device used during breast cancer surgery, now live at LDS Hospital and American Fork Hospital under the companies' prior systemwide agreement. This marks the transition of Claire from a newly-approved device into real-world commercial use at a major nonprofit health system.

news.headline: Brookline Capital Markets Starts Perimeter Medical Imaging AI at Buy; Price Target C$1.54
news.summary: Brookline Capital Markets initiated coverage of Perimeter Medical Imaging AI with a Buy rating and a C$1.54 (~US$1.11) price target, adding a new sell-side voice ahead of the Claire commercial ramp.

news.headline: Paradigm Capital Names Perimeter a Healthcare Top Pick, Alongside Profound
news.summary: Paradigm Capital added Perimeter Medical Imaging AI as a new 'Speculative Buy' healthcare Top Pick, citing the early Claire commercial rollout and pipeline of hospital leads.

news.headline: Perimeter CEO Lays Out Strategy at Planet MicroCap Showcase in Las Vegas
news.summary: CEO Adrian Mendes presented a corporate update on Claire's commercial launch, the sales funnel, and 2026 strategy at the Planet MicroCap Showcase held at the Bellagio in Las Vegas.

news.headline: Perimeter Selected for INOVAIT Pilot Fund to Advance AI for Breast Cancer Surgery
news.summary: Perimeter was chosen for a non-dilutive contribution from Canada's INOVAIT Pilot Fund to help develop next-generation AI capabilities for Claire, one of only 10 projects selected in the latest funding round.

news.headline: Perimeter Medical Imaging AI Closes Final Tranche of Non-Brokered Private Placement
news.summary: Perimeter closed the second and final tranche of its non-brokered private placement, adding capital earmarked to support the U.S. commercial launch of the newly FDA-approved Claire device.

catalysts.label: Q2 2026 earnings release
catalysts.detail: Perimeter has not yet reported Q2 2026 results as of mid-August; based on prior-quarter timing (Q1 2026 reported May 28), a report and conference call is expected in late August/early September, covering Claire placement momentum and cash runway.

catalysts.label: Claire commercial hospital placements
catalysts.detail: Company disclosed a roughly 50-lead sales funnel for Claire as of Q1 2026, with pricing well above legacy S-Series; further hospital placements beyond the Intermountain Health deployment are a key watch item.

catalysts.label: CMS New Technology APC / Medicare reimbursement decision
catalysts.detail: Claire's FDA Breakthrough Device status is expected to speed CMS review of Perimeter's planned New Technology APC filing under the Medicare Outpatient Prospective Payment System, which would formalize hospital reimbursement for Claire procedures.

catalysts.label: Breast Cancer Awareness Month seasonal ramp
catalysts.detail: Q4 has historically been Perimeter's strongest quarter, driven by Breast Cancer Awareness Month screening/surgery volumes and patients clearing insurance deductibles; now amplified by Claire's commercial availability.

catalysts.label: Potential U.S. redomiciliation / Nasdaq uplisting
catalysts.detail: Company has been evaluating a redomiciling transaction from British Columbia to a U.S. jurisdiction to remove barriers to a future Nasdaq uplisting, seen as a potential re-rating catalyst for the TSXV/OTCQX-listed microcap.

pulse: Perimeter is now in early commercial execution on Claire, its FDA-approved AI-enabled OCT device for breast cancer margin assessment, highlighted by Intermountain Health's August 13 milestone as the first U.S. health system to fully deploy Claire commercially. Fresh sell-side attention (Paradigm Capital Top Pick, Brookline Buy initiation at C$1.54) reflects growing confidence in the roughly 50-lead hospital funnel, while non-dilutive Canadian government funding (INOVAIT) and a completed private placement shore up the balance sheet for the U.S. launch. Watch for Q2 2026 results (expected early September), additional Claire hospital wins, and a potential CMS Medicare reimbursement decision by year-end as the next inflection points heading into the seasonally strong Q4 Breast Cancer Awareness Month period.
